subject: Help with adding shaded standard deviation region to geom_step() plot

messages.author: 65f44d9fbdf788d4
messages.subject: Help with adding shaded standard deviation region to geom_step() plot
parts:
Hi All,
I have a geom_step() plot I've made showing % Total C with depth. I would like to create a shaded region around each Location (line) that represents the standard deviation. I've tried geom_ribbon() but it doesn't give me what I need.

Here is my data set:


Here is my code: 

ggplot(data=depth_data, aes(x=meanC, y=TopDepth, color=Location, fill=Location))+geom_step(size=2)+geom_ribbon(aes(x=depth_data$TopDepth,ymin=depth_data$minC, ymax=depth_data$maxC,fill=Location), linetype=2, alpha=0.1)+
scale_y_reverse()+
scale_color_brewer(palette ='Set2')+scale_fill_brewer(palette="Set2")+
theme(panel.grid.minor=element_blank())+theme(panel.grid.major=element_line(color="grey75"))+xlab("Total Carbon (%)")+labs(y=expression("Depth (cm)"))+theme(axis.title=element_text(family="Times New Roman", face="bold", size=20))+ theme(strip.text.x = element_text(family="Times New Roman", face="bold",size = 30)) + theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill="white"))+theme(panel.border=element_rect(color="grey75", fill=NA, size=1)) +theme(axis.text.x=element_text(family="Times New Roman", face="bold", size =20)) +theme(axis.text.y=element_text(family="Times New Roman", face="bold", size =16)) +theme(plot.title = element_text(size=30, family="Times New Roman", face="bold", margin=margin(10,0,10,0),hjust=0.5))+theme(legend.title = element_text(colour="black", size=20, face="bold", family="Times New Roman"))+theme(legend.text = element_text(colour="black", size=18, family="Times New Roman"))

Here is the plot I have: 


Here is the plot I want (made by a colleague in JMP I think):


Any help would be appreciated! Thanks!

Hannah

--
Hannah Waterhouse, M.S.
PhD Candidate, Soils and Biogeochemistry Graduate Group
University of California, Davis

messages.author: f14d4c9d01f43388
messages.subject: Re: [D-RUG]: Help with adding shaded standard deviation region to geom_step() plot
parts:
Hi Hannah

I don't think geom_ribbon will work for step functions. Have you looked however at stat_stepribbon in package ggalt? https://rdrr.io/cran/ggalt/man/stat_stepribbon.html
It seems it will do what you are looking for?

Matthieu
